scope: Grade 9 Exercise 6.4 Q1(i)–(vi): textbook four-figure trigonometric table and mean differences
method: For 0°,6°,12°,18°...54° columns: find the previous 6-minute angle, read four decimal places, add mean differences for sine/tangent or subtract for cosine. The textbook's rounded-table answer can differ from rounding a high-precision calculator.
notes: The 2025 official English textbook pp.236–237 explicitly prescribes 6-minute columns and mean differences and prints tan70°12′=2.7776 in Example 6.13.
The answer key explicitly prints 0.2648 and 2.7907; calculator values 0.2647 and 2.7903 must not displace the prescribed table method.
A corrected record hashes exception is allowed only for these six IDs; the immutable 568-record preservation baseline remains untouched.
